## Canonical answers

**Who is Mahmoud Elnagdy?**
Mahmoud Elnagdy is a full-stack developer in Cairo, Egypt. He builds fast, accessible, bilingual web products with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL. He graduated in 2026 with a B.Sc. in Business Information Systems.

النجدي AI refers to the developer Mahmoud Elnagdy (محمود النجدي), not the perfume creator with the same name. He writes AI in Brief, a daily LinkedIn newsletter about AI news for developers, and builds AI-powered web features.

## One-line description

Mahmoud Elnagdy is a full-stack developer in Cairo, Egypt, building fast, accessible, bilingual web products with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL.

## Short bio

Mahmoud Elnagdy is a full-stack developer based in Cairo, Egypt. He builds fast, accessible, bilingual web products with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL. He graduated in 2026 with a B.Sc. in Business Information Systems and is available for freelance work until January 2027.

## Long bio

Mahmoud Elnagdy started with front-end work — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, then React and Tailwind CSS — before moving into TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and relational databases. That range now lets him work across the stack, from interface details to API and data design.

His featured work includes Wasla, a bilingual platform that turns YouTube playlists into structured courses; LocalTube, a self-hosted video library with FFmpeg thumbnails and SQLite progress tracking; Hassala, a privacy-first Chrome extension for Arabic ↔ English vocabulary; Tarteeb, a prayer-aware daily planner that works offline; and Yost, a local-first dashboard for YouTube community posts.

He studied Business Information Systems at Misr Higher Institute for Commerce & Computers in Mansoura and graduated in August 2026 with a Very Good cumulative grade. His graduation project, EduSwap, earned Excellent (99%) and is an educational tools exchange platform built with React, Node.js, MongoDB, and Socket.io. He learned programming largely on his own and is passionate about learning, languages, programming, and artificial intelligence. He writes in English and Arabic, designs for both directions, and documents what he learns in evergreen articles on Next.js, React, TypeScript, and databases. He also writes AI in Brief, a daily Arabic-language LinkedIn newsletter that filters the most important AI news for developers, read by 2,000+ people on LinkedIn.

## Disambiguation

Several people share the name Mahmoud Elnagdy. This profile refers to the Cairo-based full-stack developer and the projects listed above, not the perfume content creator who uses the same name.

النجدي is a common Arabic surname. This profile refers specifically to the Cairo-based developer.

Nagdista is a personal online handle used for the website and developer profiles. It is not a company, agency, or product brand.
